scope: Continuous straight translation of existing planar solids only. Shelves screened one at a time with other shelves retained. Front study uses upgrade door closed plus configured button/plunger reservations; side buttons are candidate envelopes. Glass, lockdown, LEDs, cables, actual fasteners, props, hinges, legs and unmodeled payloads excluded. Monitor vertical extraction is a major teardown packaging study, not the routine hinged service mode or a safe lifting procedure.
candidate_payload_scope: Full 560 x 150 shelf footprint, from shelf top upward 60 mm. Explicit packaging allowance including equipment, mounts and restrained wiring; not selected equipment or a load rating. Disconnect external harness before moving. Existing S1 audio moves with S1 in the loaded route.
